assumptions.statement: The organizer has not supplied official SITE_BOUNDARY or KEY_AREA polygons; current geometry is a low-confidence provisional constraint for topology rehearsal.
assumptions.impact: No official redline, statutory control, exact key-area relation or area-sensitive implementation claim is made.
assumptions.trigger: Replace site_boundary.geojson and key_areas.geojson when official or cleared polygons arrive, then rerun all spatial metrics, figures, HTML, PDFs and manifest hashes.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, green ratio controls, setbacks, road redlines, parking, ownership, heritage, buildings, utilities, fire, flood and public-service controls are not present in the public package.
assumptions.impact: Land-use, building, road, blue-green and phasing layers remain conceptual design suggestions; no parcel retain/renovate/demolish conclusion is statutory.
assumptions.owner: professional planning, transport, heritage and engineering teams
assumptions.trigger: Attach official schedules and surveys; recalculate control-sensitive claims before formal downstream use.

assumptions.statement: Local metering, compute, water, equipment, labor, maintenance, public-attention, procurement, funding, restoration and civic-return baselines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: The eight-ledger gate reports unknown values rather than invented totals; scenarios remain unmeasured or measuring.
assumptions.owner: named test steward with affected-group review
assumptions.trigger: Set baseline, unit, period, non-AI comparator, consent protocol and stop condition for each scenario before any scale decision.

assumptions.statement: The closeout receipt audit uses 24 deterministic synthetic fixtures; no field pilot, real participant, personal data, site authorization or service measurement is included.
assumptions.impact: Decision-match and audit-completeness metrics prove only that the documented stop rule is reproducible; they do not prove public benefit, safety, feasibility, consent or implementation performance.
assumptions.owner: future authorized pilot sponsor with professional and affected-group co-review
assumptions.trigger: Before any real-world test, assign accountable roles, secure site and data authorization, publish the staffed non-AI route, define field indicators and collect a refuse-to-sign receipt without replacing unknowns with tabletop values.

assumptions.statement: The seven responsibility-transfer interfaces and seven negative fixtures are original offline protocol evidence; no receiving role, field denominator, budget, acceptance signature, stop record, or recovery record is asserted to exist.
assumptions.impact: A protocol-valid handover can enter professional and affected-group review only. Until field evidence exists, every cost remains with the originating role and cannot be externalized to maintainers, residents, small businesses, or future public funding.
assumptions.owner: future authorized originator and receiving role with affected-group observation
assumptions.trigger: Before any field transfer, name reachable role-holders without publishing personal data, authorize measurement, preserve failed and withdrawn cases in the denominator, sign acceptance or refusal, and verify the staffed fallback and spatial recovery.

assumptions.statement: Only repository public files, user-cleared taskbook content and original agent-generated assets are used; no peer expression or unlicensed external media is imported.
assumptions.impact: Package is suitable for community display and review under COMMUNITY-DISPLAY-ONLY; external reuse requires separate permission.
assumptions.trigger: Re-audit provenance and attribution whenever a new source or asset is added.
